tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: The twelve market nodes, which are live, their regional doors and Agent Cards.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve_issuer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI and return its record summary, node and current version." → after: "Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI: the apex names the owning node and forwards to that node's regional door for the record summary."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
